related.title: 豐寧抽蓄水電站
related.transfer: 可遷移「長時儲能與電池的分工」與「27 km 水道的水頭損失」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；豐寧抽蓄水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Long-duration storage alongside batteries" and "Head loss in 27 km of waterway" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Fengning Pumped Storage Power Station must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦27 km 隧道連接兩座既有水庫的 2,200 MW、長時儲能抽蓄工程；豐寧抽蓄水電站則以世界最大的 3,600 MW 抽蓄電站與柔性直流電網的配合為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A 2,200 MW long-duration pumped-hydro project linking two existing reservoirs through 27 km of tunnels; Fengning Pumped Storage Power Station centres on the world's largest pumped-storage station at 3,600 MW and its pairing with a VSC-HVDC grid, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「上池蓄能量」與「上池蓄能量」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「變速機組與抽水調節」的模型移到豐寧抽蓄水電站，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「變速機組與抽水調節」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Energy stored in the upper reservoir" and "Energy stored in the upper reservoir".
Move the model of "Variable-speed units and pumping regulation" to Fengning Pumped Storage Power Station, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Variable-speed units and pumping regulation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「長時儲能與電池的分工」與「27 km 水道的水頭損失」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；豐寧抽蓄水電站的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Long-duration storage alongside batteries" and "Head loss in 27 km of waterway" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Fengning Pumped Storage Power Station must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 雪山 2.0 抽蓄水電工程
history.text: 2017 年計畫宣布；2019 年主體工程開工；2022 年潛盾機「佛羅倫斯」在坦坦加拉端受困；2023 年重設預算與工期，潛盾機恢復掘進；2028 年預定完工年份。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2017: The project was announced. 2019: Main works began. 2022: The TBM Florence became stuck at the Tantangara end. 2023: Budget and schedule were reset and the TBM resumed tunnelling. 2028: The target year for completion. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
